PR35_Word_followup.body:
This follow-up completes the four technical Word layout checks after PR33 merged the M6 Markdown/diagram checkpoint. Technical reports remain fixed at application source bc5aef9c62393134582affb7a690acb33ac2b833. It documents the session-unmount boundary and conservative historical-reason projection, including the original real HTTP failure and the single narrow follow-up closure.

Seven current Markdown reports include requirements, overview/detail design, test evidence, AI specification, AI development process, the student research template and submission map. Supporting material binds 76 explicitly public sources, 64 source-file hashes, 38 operations, function I/O and module/test mappings. Three new Mermaid diagrams were rendered and individually inspected; older diagrams and M4/M5 history are preserved.

Four technical Word files remain private and Git-ignored. All 33 final pages were individually opened at original detail by AI /root/documentation_checkpoint: requirements 10, design 14, test 6, AI specification 3. M4's 105 archived files retain their original hashes. Earlier layout failures and correction iterations are retained. Public hash and QA receipts: docs/reports/M6-word-qa.json and docs/reports/M6-final-validation.json.

Validation: 76 public source hashes, 14 frozen hashes, 64 fixed application hashes, seven historical reports, current/old diagram hashes, 105 M4 archive hashes, relative links, JSON, private-value scan and full diff whitespace passed. This role ran no product tests or load. MD/diagram checkpoint 13465cc6049da456a18ef669abd56806985aadf4; Word/QA checkpoint 39ef7d0d857e9c1fa0b5b4c23d378a7b53ec9050; Word source links bind e8998d6e8c34e5c55ece3567c4f08076c161fb15.

Limits: 6307 source lines still exceed the maximum; the original three formal P95 failures remain. Later stage01/stage02 and native finite-cycle publications are explicitly annexed. This does not claim native special-review approval, full independent acceptance, formal performance or release approval. Root-notified stage03/new native-review continuation falls after this document cutoff and is not read or backfilled here. Student final research and genuine human 12 edits / 3 hallucination identifications / 5 mappings remain unproven. AI authorship is explicit.

PR24 merged M4. PR33 merged only M6 MD/diagrams at head13465cc6049da456a18ef669abd56806985aadf4 (merge461553b259538fe7f6604e960458425456786efa). This new draft contains the later M4 archive, explicit public annexes, exporter layout corrections and Word QA evidence; private DOCX remain untracked. No approval, success status or main merge is requested.
